rr.alt: No political assessment was saved for this earlier report.
rr.erklaerung.fortschritt: A previously critical ministry metric improved by at least one point beyond its last credited best. No other critical metric deteriorated significantly since the previous report.
rr.erklaerung.bestaetigt: Two reports without critical ministry metrics confirm recovery. This earns additional support once.
rr.erklaerung.druck: Factions demand measurable results. Their willingness falls; affected coalition leaders lose loyalty. The leading opposition gains strength.
rr.erklaerung.geduld: The ministry remains in difficulty. There is no new progress to credit; this report changes neither support nor pressure.
rr.erklaerung.beratung: An assignment or procedure is underway. Factions allow one extra report for results, but still require actual recovery.
rr.erklaerung.gehalten: Conditions remain stable. Previously credited results do not earn another reward with every report.
rr.erklaerung.vorfall: Political consequences were already recorded for today’s ministry incident. This measurement does not charge factions again for it.
rr.erklaerung.druckpause: Problems remain visible. Fewer than 28 days have passed since the last pressure response, so there is no further deduction today.
rr.grund.zielVerfehlt: A demand due for results was missed at this measurement.
rr.grund.rueckschlag: At least one critical ministry metric deteriorated by one point or more.
rr.grund.stillstand: {n} consecutive reports without newly credited recovery.
rr.keineZusage: Political demands for results, not automatically accepted promises. Party roles and values reflect this report’s date.
rr.schritte: Review the ministry proposal and its funding. A conversation can protect relationships, but cannot fulfil a result target. Laws and assignments must take effect first.
rr.gefahr: At this report: {parteien} below 20 loyalty. If unchanged, the coalition review on {datum} could leave {nach} rather than {vor} government seats.
rr.hilfe: Open faction negotiations for a conversation and address the ministry problem as well. This warning does not predict other events.
rr.pause: Next possible pressure deduction from this series no earlier than {datum}; other incidents retain their own consequences.
rr.regel: Assessment uses actual ministry metrics. New progress starts at one point beyond the last credited best of a critical metric. A setback in another critical metric takes priority. Two critical reports without new results trigger pressure, or three during active work. A setback or missed due demand can trigger pressure earlier; deductions occur at most every 28 days.
rr.preise: Progress: coalition willingness +2, minister’s party leader +1 loyalty, other factions +1 willingness, opposition −1 strength. Confirmed recovery once: +4, responsible coalition leader +2 and other coalition leaders +1, other factions +1, opposition −2. Pressure: responsible coalition party −3 willingness/−2 loyalty, other partners −2/−1, other factions −1 willingness, opposition +2 strength. Actual values are limited to 0–100. No faction booking for the player’s own party.
rr.forderungsregel: Under pressure, one coalition partner and the leading opposition demand a two-point improvement in the most urgent ministry metric within 28 days. Reaching the all-clear range also suffices. Ministry reports assess results. A new conversation or minister change does not extend this deadline. Past successes earn no repeated bonus.
rr.opp.druck: Following {name}’s ministry report, {partei} demands measurable results and increases political pressure.
rr.opp.erfolg: Following {name}’s ministry report, criticism from {partei} loses strength: measurements show progress.
